name: Header
summary: The AhaSlides marketing site header (Webflow component Header, variant name "Variant"): a participant join bar above the main navigation, with Products, Solutions and Resources dropdowns, Pricing, Enterprise, the language switch and Log in / Sign up, collapsing to a hamburger menu at 991px and below. Framework-free and bound entirely to the shared --aha-* tokens.
highlights: Webflow component Header, variant name "Variant" (Pattern / Marketing / Header)
Participant bar with join code, main nav with three dropdowns, language switch, Log in and Sign up
Hamburger menu at 991px and below, dropdowns become an accordion
Brand mark is <aha-product-lockup>, icons are <aha-icon> by name
